content.value: Consider a scenario where information is being stored using the following union.
The system being used utilizes an Intel CPU that adheres to the little-endian architecture. Given that key . i has a value of 123456 and the storage size of the int type is 4 bytes,
i) Estimate the decimal value of key.ch[0] to key.ch[3] as well as the value stored in key.val.
ii) Interpret the memory layout in which the values are stored.
